scope: bounded engineering of the new PushAnyShape Disk task; no optimization or learning claim

task.integral_error: bounded signed leaky integral of the controlled position coordinates; eta_yaw=0
task.target_yaw: free; canonical task frame yaw zero; physical yaw retained for body-mode execution
task.nominal_C_model: 12 radial inward unit translations in body frame; yaw response zero; not a measured contact response
task.controller: PushAnyShape one-step complete state-dependent certificate flow and endpoint screening plus mode persistence
task.executor: geometric approach/bypass/engage/push/disengage/settled phase machine; no predicted-trajectory cost search
task.forbidden_old_planner: standalone contact_single_disk 18 candidates and 125-step scoring are not used

actor.matrix: I6 from public Cholesky map, trace six, floor .05
actor.claim: unit-M engineering baseline; not a trained policy

physics.model_source: exact XML copied from the retained standalone planar viscous single-disk model
physics.actual_elapsed_time: sum accepted physical substeps; failed rejected substep does not advance accepted time

evaluation.success: all actual physical goal conditions true at all final 51 control endpoints; no physical failure
evaluation.hold_eta_rule: task declares goal_hold; suppress physical-error integral drive and retain leakage; do not reset eta or force V to zero
evaluation.physical_error_E: squared disk-goal position in meters + squared disk velocity m/s + squared yaw rate rad/s + squared pusher velocity m/s + squared positive .002m gap residual
evaluation.fixed_horizon_cost: left accepted_dt integration of physical_error_E; any unsafe failure fills remaining 30s by max(terminal physical_error_E,25)
record: M and V at actual endpoints
nominal candidate descent and model mismatch

comparison_limitations: The old standalone task uses an eight-dimensional episode-fixed M and another planner.
This new task uses six-dimensional pose-plus-integral M and PushAnyShape mode selection.
New position tolerance .005m differs from the old standalone .008m.
Matching starts do not make this an equal-controller or equal-training-budget comparison.

full_execution_requires: frozen extension source and config hashes
bounded contract engineering completed and independently checked
gates.task_or_executor_change_after_execution: retain old evidence; declare a new revision before running changed sources
